release_notes: Adds a live progress bar during OTA download and preparation, including transferred MB for the target and rollback installers.
Keeps a visible Quotation Manager Update window on screen after the main app closes so the update transition no longer looks like a crash.
Shows clear stages for installing, restarting, validating the updated application, completing the update, and restoring the previous version if rollback is required.
Uses an indeterminate installation bar when Inno Setup cannot provide a trustworthy percentage instead of displaying a fake progress value.
Fixes the shared scrolling surface so mouse-wheel scrolling moves in small consistent increments and supports precision touchpad input without large visual jumps.
Database schema remains 8; calculations, numbering, exports, document renderers, templates, revisions, and cancellation workflows are unchanged.
